title: Deep neural networks as lattice gauge theories
abstract: arXiv:2608.19331v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We modify the NN/QFT duality [1] to incorporate the layerwise permutation symmetry of the network, resulting in a $(0\!+\!1)$-dimensional lattice gauge theory, in which each layer of $N$ neurons acts as an $N$-component lattice site, and the weight matrices play the role of gauge fields living on the links. In this framework, we compute the tree-level neuron-neuron propagator which describes the evolution of layer variance in the network, and develop the Feynman diagram machinery to compute interactions in the perturbative expansion in $1/N$. In particular, we obtain a recursive expression for all corrections to the exact propagator at $O(1)$, representing statistical fluctuations in the ensemble of networks, including infinitely-many loop diagrams mediating the interactions from previous layers. translated_title: 深度神经网络作为晶格规范理论
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.19331v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：我们修改了NN/QFT对偶性[1]，以纳入网络的逐层置换对称性，从而得到一个$(0\!+\!1)$维晶格规范理论，其中每层$N$个神经元充当一个$N$分量晶格位点，而权重矩阵则扮演位于链接上的规范场的角色。在此框架下，我们计算了描述网络中层层方差演化的树级神经元-神经元传播子，并发展了费曼图机制来计算$1/N$微扰展开中的相互作用。特别地，我们获得了精确传播子在$O(1)$阶所有修正的递归表达式，这些修正代表了网络系综中的统计涨落，包括无数个介导前层相互作用的圈图。我们还对神经元散射振幅进行了初步分析，这些振幅在$1/N$中逐阶贡献，从而提供了一种场论视角。
tldr: 本文通过将深度神经网络的逐层置换对称性纳入NN/QFT对偶性，构建了一个(0+1)维晶格规范理论，并利用费曼图技术推导出神经元传播子的递归修正及散射振幅，为理解网络统计涨落提供了场论框架。
en_tdlr: This paper constructs a (0+1)-dimensional lattice gauge theory by incorporating layerwise permutation symmetry into the NN/QFT duality, and uses Feynman diagram techniques to derive recursive corrections to neuron propagators and scattering amplitudes, offering a field-theoretic framework for understanding statistical fluctuations in networks.
